dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 27, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**ASTROS TAKE DOWN TIGERS IN HIGH-SCORING AFFAIR**

A pair of power-hitting performances led the Houston Astros to an 8-6 win over the Detroit Tigers. Kerry Carpenter went 2-for-4 with a home run and four RBIs, while Jeremy Peña added a key hit to help the Astros secure the victory. On the mound, AJ Blubaugh earned the win with 2.0 scoreless innings of relief.

**REDS TAKE DOWN PIRATES IN WILD GAME**

The Cincinnati Reds outlasted the Pittsburgh Pirates 9-7 in a back-and-forth contest. Eugenio Suárez hit a three-run homer to highlight the Reds' offense, while Brandon Lowe added a four-RBI performance. Chase Burns tossed 6.0 innings for the Reds, striking out 10 batters.

**RAINFALL OF HOMERS IN MLB ACTION**

Rafael Devers hit two home runs, including a pair of two-run shots, in the San Francisco Giants' 5-0 win over the Atlanta Braves. The Giants' Logan Webb was nearly unhittable, tossing 7.0 scoreless innings with six strikeouts. In the Los Angeles Dodgers' 15-3 rout of the San Diego Padres, Kyle Tucker hit a home run and drove in four runs.
